comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a robot-gripper opening stop; PR-2260 packs a rolled poster into a mailing tube and seats an end cap at each end.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial driver and wrench manipulation with countertorque; PR-2260 requires long-object alignment and insertion, tube stabilization, and coaxial press-fitting of two caps.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked 90° setting, three repeatable cycles, retained nuts, and clearance; PR-2260 requires the roll sufficiently inside, one or both caps geometrically seated, hands off, stillness, real-world cap retention, and no poster damage.
comparison.reason: Long-roll packing and friction-cap insertion do not test coupled adjustment locking or articulated setting retention; no material success-condition detail is missing.
